test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is not associated with Tabla?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shakoor Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shakoor Khan** was a renowned **Sarangi player**.
 
• He was known for his** unique style and mastery of the instrument.**
 
• The** Sarangi is a bowed, short-necked string instrument **from India that is known for its ability to imitate the human voice.
 
• Shakoor Khan’s music has been appreciated by audiences worldwide.
 
• Despite his association with the Sarangi, Shakoor Khan’s name is often mistakenly associated with the Tabla due to the commonality of the surname ‘Khan’ among many Indian classical musicians.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jnan Prakash Ghosh** was a harmonium and tabla player from India.

 
 
• He was also a composer, teacher, and scholar of Indian classical music.
 
• He trained many eminent musicians, such as Ravi Shankar, Anindo Chatterjee, and Ajoy Chakrabarty.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contributions to music.
 
 
 
• **Sabir Khan** is a renowned Indian tabla player.
 
 
• He is the son and disciple of the legendary tabla maestro Ustad Zakir Hussain.
 
• He has performed with many eminent artists, such as Pandit Ravi Shankar, Ustad Amjad Ali Khan, and Pandit Shivkumar Sharma.
 
• He is known for his versatility, creativity, and mastery over various styles of tabla playing.
 
 
 
• **Sandeep Das**, a Grammy-winning Indian Tabla virtuoso, has built a diverse international career collaborating with some of the world’s leading musicians.
 
 
• He is a founding member of the Silk Road Ensemble, a musical group led by cellist Yo-Yo Ma.
 
• He has performed at prestigious venues, such as Carnegie Hall, Kennedy Center, and Royal Albert Hall.
 
• He is also a composer, educator, and social entrepreneur who promotes cross-cultural dialogue through music.
 
 

***Hence, The correct answer is option 1.***
